nodes.label: Housing and development sites
nodes.description: Housing, development and planning records that can change local demand and surfaces.

nodes.label: Public transport stops and routes
nodes.description: Stops, routes, timetables and connectivity that shape access to services.

nodes.label: Rivers, water bodies and drainage assets
nodes.description: Rivers, catchments, drains, culverts and water infrastructure relevant to flood pathways.

nodes.label: Roads and streets
nodes.description: Road networks, road assets, junctions, crossings, lighting and traffic context.

nodes.label: Schools and education places
nodes.description: Schools and education facilities that affect vulnerable-user and service-access context.

nodes.label: Population need and demographics
nodes.description: Population, age, households, disability, deprivation and other need indicators.

nodes.label: Rainfall and weather conditions
nodes.description: Rainfall, forecasts and weather observations that can change flood and service conditions over time.

nodes.label: Terrain, soil and ground conditions
nodes.description: Elevation, slope, soil, geology and groundwater conditions that shape runoff or constraints.

nodes.label: Road collisions and casualties
nodes.description: Historic collision and casualty records used as context, not as fault or blackspot findings.

nodes.label: Agricultural production validation labels
nodes.description: Forecast skill must be validated against observed yield or harvest outcome labels.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Crop-yield labels are required before accuracy can be scored.

nodes.label: Collision and casualty history
nodes.description: Historic collisions are evidence of prior safety performance, not proof of current fault.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Collision source is missing or not granular enough.

nodes.label: Drainage, culverts and road barriers
nodes.description: Roads, embankments and drainage capacity can redirect or block flows.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Drainage/culvert data is often missing from public catalogues.

nodes.label: Elevation, slope and flow paths
nodes.description: Low elevation and local slope determine where water can accumulate or move.

properties.missingIfAbsent: DEM/LiDAR flow-path processing is not yet available.

nodes.label: Growing-season rainfall and temperature
nodes.description: Excess rain, drought, frost and heat affect crop development and harvest conditions.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Weather observations are not yet crop-zone normalized.

nodes.label: Impervious surface and land cover
nodes.description: Built surfaces reduce absorption and increase runoff.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Land-cover/impervious-surface evidence is incomplete.

nodes.label: Incident and collision validation labels
nodes.description: Historical incidents and response records are needed for backtesting and calibration.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Validated incident labels are required before measuring model accuracy.

nodes.label: Infrastructure capacity and public assets
nodes.description: Development pressure should be read against infrastructure and service capacity.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Capacity datasets are partial or absent.

nodes.label: Land, soil and groundwater context
nodes.description: Soils and drainage mediate how weather becomes crop stress.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Soil and land-cover layers are not yet normalized for crop zones.

nodes.label: Nearby environmental constraints
nodes.description: Environmental overlaps can shape planning interpretation.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Environmental constraint layers are not fully connected.

nodes.label: Nearby schools, hospitals and public places
nodes.description: Nearby vulnerable users change the interpretation of road context.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Vulnerable asset locations are not fully joined.

nodes.label: Population need and demographics
nodes.description: Service access must be compared with who lives nearby and what they need.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Demographic need data is missing at the right geography.

nodes.label: Rain, frost, ice and surface weather
nodes.description: Precipitation and freezing temperatures are primary contextual signals for slippery road potential.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Weather source is missing or not joined to road segments.

nodes.label: Rainfall intensity and duration
nodes.description: Heavy or prolonged rainfall can increase runoff and river levels.

properties.missingIfAbsent: No rainfall/precipitation source is connected yet.

nodes.label: River level and upstream/downstream cascade
nodes.description: Upstream river levels can propagate downstream over time.

properties.missingIfAbsent: River gauge and cascade evidence is incomplete.

nodes.label: Road layout and vulnerable-user infrastructure
nodes.description: Layout and infrastructure affect how people move through a road environment.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Road-design asset evidence is incomplete.

nodes.label: Road network exposure
nodes.description: Forecasting must attach weather conditions to the specific road network that people use.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Road-segment exposure evidence is incomplete.

nodes.label: Service and facility locations
nodes.description: Access starts with reliable location and service data.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Service directories are incomplete or stale.

nodes.label: Soil saturation and infiltration capacity
nodes.description: Saturated or low-infiltration ground increases surface runoff.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Soil/groundwater evidence is missing or not yet joined.

nodes.label: Traffic volume and exposure
nodes.description: Collision counts need traffic exposure to avoid misleading comparisons.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Exposure denominator is missing.

nodes.label: Transport connectivity
nodes.description: Public transport determines whether services are practically reachable.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Transport frequency and travel-time evidence is incomplete.

nodes.label: Zoning and land-use policy
nodes.description: Planning policy defines what development is permitted or encouraged.

properties.missingIfAbsent: Zoning and plan layers are incomplete.
